id./param/scenario/cs/b_080_cs_110.pack|cs_: "Babies are so small. He feels like he'd break. Lady Eleanor, may I touch {var:1}?
"Hee hee. {var:1} seems to like Jade. He says he wants to play.
"...{var:1} is a child of hope, born a Luminary.
"When he grows, I hope he's strong and sturdy like his father, overcoming any hardship.
"If he takes after Lady Eleanor, he'll be kind to everyone, I'm sure!
"Now, Eleanor. The Colloquy is about to start. Hand me {var:1}.
"{var:1}! Where we're going is full of scary old men, but Daddy will protect you no matter what!
"Honestly, you. Holding him so tight, it hurts. Right, {var:1}?
"On a special day like today, the weather turning like this. I've had a bad feeling.
"Eleanor, don't worry. I'll protect you and {var:1} no matter what.
"Ha ha ha. Jade's father is the strong, brave King of Heliodor. Far more reliable than me!
"...Well, it's time for the meeting. I'm off. Eleanor, I leave things to you.
